items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Fuzzy Knight. Remember Fuzzy Knight, he used to do some singing there.

ctx.x: Fuzzy Knight. Remember Fuzzy Knight, he used to do some singing there. And later he went out in the movies and did a lot of hillbilly stuff. He was a hillbilly.

But this band, they had a job up in Syracuse in a Chinese-American restaurant. The guy came to me one time and he asked me if I'd like to take that job. He said, 'I think your band could do it well and you might like to do a job like that, the thing is you have to play two hours, and -- two hours from 6 to 8 and then you come back at 9 and play until 12. It's a lot of work, but you could get paid reasonably well.'
